name: Raise Robotics Work Cell on AGV
summary: A robot arm on a self-driving base that prints layout, drills anchor holes, fastens curtain-wall embeds or scans as-built geometry, depending on the tool fitted.

priceOther.market: US, Raise V4 AGV base alone "from" (without work cell); lease options available

germany.statusNote: Sold direct business to business by the US maker (Newark, NJ): purchase, lease or financing. No European seller, office or customer found; the maker only says each platform can be configured for ATEX Zone 2 in Europe.

specs.label: Platforms
specs.value: Raise AGV, Genie scissor lifts, Genie boom lifts

specs.label: AGV design payload
specs.conditions: base platform only; the work cell counts against it

specs.label: Runtime
specs.conditions: base platform at 500-600 W draw; runtime with work cell not stated

notes: Omnidirectional four-wheel base; the fitted tool sets the job (mark, drill, fasten or scan).
The same work cell can also be mounted on Genie scissor and boom lifts.
